description: This file contains a test class 'ThemeImageTest' that verifies the functionality of the 'ThemeImage' Data Transfer Object (DTO) within the 'OrangeHRM' Human Resource Management system. The test case specifically checks creation from an array and the correctness of getter methods for the properties 'content', 'filename', 'fileType', and 'fileSize'.

classes.name: ThemeImageTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for the 'ThemeImage' DTO, testing creation and property access methods.

methods.name: testCreateFromArray
methods.description: Tests the static factory method 'createFromArray' of 'ThemeImage' for null input and proper array input, and verifies that getters return expected values.
